rule_text: Standard sizing baseline -- apply all five by default, every request, unless the request explicitly says otherwise: sub_status = 'A' (active subscribers only); stop_sell = 0 (not contactable otherwise); standard_exclusions = 0 (not contactable otherwise); control_group_flg = 'N' (not contactable otherwise); primary_sub = 1 (only the decision-maker on each account is contacted).

Override rule: if the request explicitly asks to include stop-sell, control-group, non-primary, or non-active subscribers (e.g. 'including stop sell', 'the full base regardless of contactability'), drop the corresponding default above for that request only.
When a request says 'customers' without further qualification, count at the individual subscriber/line level (one row in this table = one count), not the billing account (BAN) level.

DNC flags (em_dnc, ob_dnc, sms_dnc, dm_dnc) are channel-specific, not a blanket filter: none are filtered by default. When a request specifies a particular communication channel (e.g. 'an email campaign', 'an outbound calling list'), apply that channel's DNC flag as a filter (e.g. em_dnc = 0 for an email campaign). When no channel is specified, none of the four are applied.

For curr_pplan, last_channel_group, prizm_socialgrp_cd, and prizm_lifestage_cd, no full catalog of valid values is stored. When a request names a specific code or value for one of these (e.g. 'SOC XYZ123', 'channel RETAIL'), use it directly as given. When a request doesn't name one, don't filter on that column and don't guess a value for it.
Both 'PQ' and 'QC' appear as province codes for Quebec in this table. Any request filtering on Quebec must match both codes.
The audience should include all subscribers belonging to postpaid Lines of Business (LOBs).
Exclude subscribers who are on a month-to-month contract.
Do not filter on `commit_end_date` unless customer lifecycle is explicitly mentioned in the prompt.
